subject: AWS Offer page: hero messaging, evidence matrix, and co-sell badging
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Offer page: hero messaging, evidence matrix, and co-sell badging

Hi Lena / AWS team —

Attaching our first-pass offer page PDF and an evidence matrix (both attached). We want to sync on three quick things before we lock copy for the listing:

1) Hero signal: short value line + one-sentence subtext. Our draft leads with "Predictable inference at cloud scale — reduce per-token costs by up to 4x for batch workloads." Do we think the angled savings claim is okay for the hero, or should that move into the body/footnote?

2) Trust & evidence: the evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx maps trust claims (SOC2, data residency, private VPC) to artifacts. AWS asked for a single proof spreadsheet for the co-sell review — I consolidated what we have but Lena, can you confirm the enterprise Procure team has the missing SOC2 attestation?

3) Co-sell badging and CTA: we want the "Co-sell qualified" badge and for the trial CTA to route to a private-offer request flow. Is the marketplace team OK with a private-offer CTA showing on the product page hero?

Next steps I propose: AWS confirms badge policy and legal phrasing, Nimbus confirms artifact availability, and we iterate copy with two short options for the hero (A: savings-forward; B: reliability-forward).

Attached: redwood_aws_listing_draft_v1.pdf, evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0129
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Offer page: hero messaging, evidence matrix, and co-sell badging

Marissa — quick read and a couple of suggested edits before we hand to AWS: 

- Hero options: I prefer reliability-forward for enterprise buyers. Proposed A/B: 
  A) "Predictable inference at cloud scale — save on per-token costs for bulk workloads"
  B) "SLO-driven inference: sub-100ms tail latency and cost controls for production apps"

- Footnote language: move the specific savings number out of hero and into a footnote that references the evidence matrix (so we don't overpromise on varied workloads).

- CTA behavior: private-offer CTA in the hero is fine so long as we fallback to a standard trial if private-offer isn't available in a region. Add a short line for the field: "Request a dedicated trial or start a demo" (link to private-offer form and demo scheduler).

I updated the draft PDF with inline copy suggestions (see attachment redwood_aws_listing_draft_v1.pdf — v1 comments). I'm also attaching a pared-down evidence summary view in the Drive link (private).

On the SOC2: I pinged Legal to confirm the attestation is up-to-date; Kimberly, can you confirm?

Onwards,
Jonas
Product Marketing | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 17:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Offer page: hero messaging, evidence matrix, and co-sell badging

Thanks Marissa/Jonas — good set of materials. A few answers and asks from Marketplace: 

- Hero claims: moving a quantified savings claim into a body/footnote is the right approach. We prefer the reliability-forward hero for enterprise listings; B looks better operationally.

- Co-sell badge: to qualify for the "Co-sell qualified" designation we need the following in the evidence matrix: SOC2 Type II date, an explicit private-offer workflow doc, and a named field contact. Once those are present we can queue the offer for a co-sell review (typical SLA 5 business days).

- Private-offer CTA: Marketplace is OK with showing a private-offer CTA in the hero if the product page also surfaces the standard free trial path for non-eligible buyers. We will need the private-offer request URL and a fallback link to the demo scheduler.

- Legal copy: for footnotes referencing savings use: "Savings are workload dependent; representative findings from customer benchmarks. See evidence." That phrasing keeps claims non-prescriptive. Legal will ask to see the benchmark details if you keep any numeric claims.

Please upload the updated evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx with the SOC2 date and the private-offer workflow doc linked inside, then reply-all so we can kick the co-sell review.

Best,
Alexandra Ruiz
AWS Marketplace Program Manager
aws-marketplace@amazon.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Jul 2028 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Offer page: hero messaging, evidence matrix, and co-sell badging

Thanks Alex — that's clear and actionable. Quick status update: 

- Kimberly confirmed SOC2: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> confirms we have SOC2 Type II, attestation date 2028-04-15; I've added that to the matrix.

- Private-offer workflow: attached a short runbook (uploaded to Drive) and added the request URL to the evidence matrix. Nimbus (Lena) has supplied the named field contact for procurement and confirmed they will accept the private-offer terms for the pilot.

- Copy decisions: we will go with Jonas' reliability-forward hero (B) for the initial listing; savings mention moved to a body bullet plus the legal footnote Alex suggested.

I've attached the updated evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx (now v3 on Drive) and a redline of the listing PDF. Once Marketplace confirms receipt and queues co-sell review, we'll follow up with the field enablement package (one-pager + demo script).

Attachments: evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx (updated), redwood_aws_listing_draft_v1.pdf (redline comments)

Next steps: Alex — please confirm you have what you need to start the 5-business-day co-sell review.

Thanks all —
Marissa
